worked.problem: A closed cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 6 cm. Give its volume and total surface area exactly in terms of π.
actions: Label the radius 3 cm, height 6 cm and two circular ends.
One circular base has area π × 3² = 9π cm².
Volume = base area × height = 9π × 6 = 54π cm³.
The curved rectangle has area 2π × 3 × 6; add two bases: total surface area = 54π cm².
Check: both circular ends are included and radius, not diameter, is squared.
worked.check: Check: both circular ends are included and radius, not diameter, is squared.
worked.misconception: Distinguish length, square and cubic units; count each face once, then verify the given radius, height and conversion.
